description: Envelope follower — a CV tracking the amplitude at IN

params.text: Slows and smooths how quickly the output follows a change in the input
Cuts the output by as much as -36dB below noon, or lifts it by as much as +12dB above noon

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over the damping, attenuated by the DAMP knob
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, over the gain
The signal whose amplitude is followed; the channels patched here set the polyphony

outputs.text: A CV proportional to the amplitude of the input
